summary: The propose-plan skill teaches the new kinds, their categories, and sections
riskReason: The skill steers every future plan. It's other, not instructions, because a plan can only use kinds that exist when it's stored.

rules.text: the skill's kind list includes instructions and docs, with what each needs, and says non-semantic is only typos, formatting, and pure moves
the skill says each kind's change categories come from docs/model/categories.md, and a change none fits is uncategorized
the skill says prose kinds name targets in expect.sections, and the no-paths rule applies to code kinds

evidence: dry run: plan a one-paragraph docs change with the skill, and plan-view validates it
